extraction_notes: Extraction was made visually from the Doc20 Raw + components schematic and crops only; no GT, Raw+wires, OCR engines, or outside resources were used.
Matrix encodes asserted direct drawn adjacencies only; uncertain_edges are not set to 1 in the matrix.
Bus wire tags BUS-13K-A/B, BUS-416-A/B, BUS-480-A/B/C/D, and BUS-125DCA/B are treated as aliases/evidence for the named bus nodes, not separate duplicate nodes.

Unlabeled small terminal squares in generator/DG source chains were not modeled as nodes; the adjacent labeled source-to-breaker edge is asserted with medium confidence where the conductor visibly passes through the square.

Line-type assignment follows the sheet legend: solid AC feeder, dashed control/interlock, dot-dash instrumentation/signal. Battery/charger/rectifier DC source group edges use kind 'other' because the JSON kind enum has no dedicated DC feeder value.
For buses, direct edges are only from the bus node to the tapped breaker/device/source/rectifier/inverter at a visible junction dot or direct bus tap.
Crossings and close approaches without junction dots were not promoted to connections.
Hard-to-read labels were visually resolved as MOT-CRN-01A, PMP-CCP-207C, MOV-RWST-24D, and CB-416A-IN/CB-416B-IN from the 2x crops.
